wholePhysicalScope: The mapped memorial enclosure and nine cabin outlines establish the layout. The 2010 reconstruction followed the pre-flood arrangement; modern mapped traces are used as an approximate registration.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the dated timber huts and the hillside profiles. Closer levels add the wooden footway rails, shutters and roof planks.
limitations: The placement shows the documented pavilion exteriors in the pre-flood preserved site. The hospital had fourteen named cabins; the model covers the nine structures with mapped footprints and the adjoining visible walk.
The surviving map mostly records the reconstructed site. Exact pre-flood footprints, the small ledges under the huts and the historical stream bed are approximate.
The two photos document a preserved appearance from 2006–2007, several decades after the hospital operated. Current flood repair is outside this historical placement.
